personal.name: James Mitchell
personal.title: Finance Manager
personal.about: Finance Manager with 10 years of experience in financial planning, analysis, and reporting for multinational corporations. CPA and CFA charterholder with expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and strategic financial modeling. Known for translating complex financial data into actionable business insights.

experience.description:
Managing a $50M annual operating budget across 3 business units with a team of 6 analysts
Developed a rolling forecast model that improved budget accuracy from 85% to 96%
Led the financial due diligence for 2 acquisitions totaling $15M
Presenting monthly financial reviews to the executive leadership team and board of directors

Provided financial advisory services to Fortune 500 clients across technology and healthcare sectors
Built complex financial models for M&A transactions and capital restructuring
Managed audit engagements for publicly traded companies

Performed valuation analysis and financial modeling for investment banking division
Supported deal execution for IPOs and debt offerings totaling $2B+

education.description: Beta Gamma Sigma honor society. Concentration in Corporate Finance.
Magna Cum Laude. Minor in Statistics.
